content.text:
I created the file and the write went through. The exact tool result was:

> File created successfully at: <LIVE>\D-2-Write-1\repo\service.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

A PreToolUse hook also added this notice to the call:

> Mneme availability: authorization could not be verified (AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE, reason VERIFIER_CONFIG_MISSING). This edit proceeded without fail-closed availability enforcement.

So the hook couldn't find its verifier config, and the write happened without the fail-closed check from ADR-033.
